text_block_list.text:
Traditionally, Umamusume who sought
the Triple
Crown have gone on to focus
on medium- and
long-distance races.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But I've decided to set my eyes on the

Takamatsunomiya Kinen and dominate
sprints.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm choosing my own first-rate path this
time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Even if it turns out to be a mistake, I
won't regret
it.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: And if it is...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: It still won't be too late to start over.

text_block_list.text: Hehe. You seem prepared as well.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well then, let's get started. This is our—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ....It's my mother.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Heh, what fine timing. Here, hold my
phone up
for me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Don't "huh" me. I said hold it.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Okay, the angle is fine. All right, here
we go.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: BeЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hello, Mother.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Just what do you think you're doing
now?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Don't think I haven't heard. You're
running in the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. I'm here to win.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So you admit you've gone insane. This is
an
entirely different field—1,200 meters
on turf. Do
you understand that?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text:
It's a sprint. Your strategy for
long-distance races
won't work here.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text: It's absurd to assume you can suddenly win in a G1 against professionals! Have you even seen what the reporters have been writing about you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Mother

text_block_list.text: You realize I'm also a pro, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I chose this race because I'm an
experienced
first-rate Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says, I have
confidence in
my ability to win.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Just wait and watch. I'll show you what I
can do.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: BeЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well, I've said my piece. Let's get going.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: It's time for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
